MLB Postseason Model

Every remaining series simulated plate appearance by plate appearance, from the actual bracket: announced starters where they exist, each team's rotation and lineups from its recent games, each bullpen as it stands, and real reliever fatigue. Each simulation plays out the rest of October, so the odds below account for who each team would likely face next.

How the numbers are made

Data: Baseball Savant (Statcast) and the MLB Stats API, subject to MLB Advanced Media's terms. Betting lines: DraftKings via ESPN, shown as a benchmark only and never used by the model. Code: github.com/WhyNot616/alcs-matchup-model.
